title: The Tin Box Under the Tree

scenes.title: Três pedras ao norte (Three Stones North)
scenes.summary: At dawn on Saturday before the upstairs guests wake, F1, M1, and M2 count three flat flagstones north from the courtyard shade tree.

scenes.title: Envolto em pano encerado (Wrapped in Waxed Cloth)
scenes.summary: F2 brings hot morning coffee from the kitchen just as M1 lifts the third stone and uncovers a dry parcel wrapped in heavy waxed cloth.

scenes.title: A lata de biscoitos (The Biscuit Tin)
scenes.summary: Inside sunlit Room 9, F1, F2, and M2 untie the waxed cloth to reveal a painted red-and-gold biscuit tin sealed thirty summers ago.

scenes.title: A bússola de latão (The Brass Compass)
scenes.summary: M1 eases open the stiff tin lid with a drop of oil, and he and F1 discover a shining brass pocket compass resting on top.

scenes.title: Quatro cartões ilustrados (Four Illustrated Cards)
scenes.summary: Room 4 guest F3 and architect M3 examine four watercolour clue cards from the tin, and M3 recognises the signature mark of his retired cartography professor.

scenes.title: Metade de uma receita de bolo (Half of a Cake Recipe)
scenes.summary: In the café corner, F2, F3, and M4 read a neatly torn card holding only the top half of the famous summer berry-and-almond cake recipe.

scenes.title: Cinco jovens amigos (Five Young Friends)
scenes.summary: M2, F3, and M3 admire a thirty-year-old charcoal sketch from the bottom of the tin showing five smiling friends around a courtyard table.

scenes.title: Sigam as quatro pistas primeiro (Walk All Four Clues First)
scenes.summary: At the front desk, F1, M1, and M3 inspect a small wax-sealed envelope instructing them to walk all four neighbourhood clues along {STREET} before breaking the seal.
